name: 15_gearbox_tests
description: Mouse/Keyboard driving: accelerating and braking with different cars. The LFS-side gearbox mode is NOT set by this recording and decides what the run tests - always confirm it with the driver before starting.
preconditions: LFS is running with InSim enabled on port 29999
LFS is at the main menu
LFS control mode is mouse/keyboard - this recording replays mouse input and steers with it; in wheel/joystick mode the car does not move

ASK THE DRIVER which gearbox mode is set (SHIFT+G) and record it with the run. Mouse/keyboard offers manual and automatic; wheel/joystick offers automatic, sequential and H-pattern. The add-on's automatic gearbox only acts in mouse/keyboard 'manual' or wheel/joystick 'sequential' - with PIF_AUTOGEARS set it stands down and the run tests nothing. Two live runs (2026-09-19, 2026-09-20) were wasted this way.
